description: State accounts from MoSPI: gross and net state domestic product, income per person, growth and value added by industry, for each state and union territory.
units: ₹ crore for levels (value added, taxes and subsidies converted from ₹ lakh); ₹ for per-person figures; % for growth. 'cur' = current prices, 'con' = constant 2011-12 prices. 'derived': worked out as GSVA + taxes - subsidies (MoSPI publishes no GSDP for the state); growth with 'published': false is worked out from the levels.
left_out: Karnataka: NSDP per person (second table, ind32) is not below the gross figure, 2011-12 to 2025-26 (15 years), 2011-12 base; left out
Karnataka: net state value added (ind30) is not below the gross figure, 2011-12 to 2025-26 (15 years), 2011-12 base; left out
